name: Pixel Agents OpenClaw Relay
description: Projects content-free OpenClaw lifecycle events into a local or remote Pixel Agents office.

agentNames.label: Agent display name overrides
agentNames.help: Map OpenClaw agent IDs to office names. Overrides identity.name and agent name; no channel configuration is needed.

gatewayId.label: Gateway identity namespace
gatewayId.help: Optional stable, unique namespace when multiple Gateways on the same machine share an office. Defaults to host and OpenClaw state/config location.

localDiscovery.label: Discover local Pixel Agents servers
localDiscovery.help: Send events to live Pixel Agents servers registered for this OS user. Enabled by default.

remote.endpoint.label: Remote hook endpoint
remote.endpoint.help: Final URL ending in /api/hooks/openclaw. Use HTTPS except for loopback testing.

remote.token.label: Remote relay token
remote.token.help: Dedicated hook-only credential from the Pixel Agents server's ~/.pixel-agents/relay-token file.
